scope: 28 selected widely used compiler, build and dev ecosystems; illustrative cross-section, not a statistically ranked top-28 by usage
primary_evidence: linked vendor/upstream project documentation; maturity and feature claims are scoped to the specified layer and not benchmarked head-to-head

reference_implementations.name: Rust/rustc
reference_implementations.mechanism: Red/green query DAG, persisted query results and codegen-unit reuse
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Query-level invalidation plus persisted IR/object results; avoid marking cached values green without rederived dependencies

reference_implementations.name: Swift compiler/driver
reference_implementations.mechanism: Fine-grained source dependency files and incremental frontend jobs
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Record per-source provided/referenced declarations; schedule source jobs independently and revise dependency graph when emitted metadata changes

reference_implementations.name: Kotlin Gradle plugin
reference_implementations.mechanism: Classpath API snapshots and dependent class recompilation
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Compare actual exported API separately from implementation text, including non-source dependencies

reference_implementations.name: Scala/sbt Zinc
reference_implementations.mechanism: Name/member reference hashes and class-based dependency analysis
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Refine file/namespace invalidation to exported declarations and symbol-usage edges, preserving inheritance/implicit effects

reference_implementations.name: TypeScript/tsc
reference_implementations.mechanism: On-disk tsbuildinfo and project-reference declaration boundaries
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Persist analysis by package/profile and use verified interface artifacts between build units

reference_implementations.name: Go cmd/go
reference_implementations.mechanism: Package/action identity build cache and compiled export data
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Make package-instance keys stable and reproducible across compiler processes

reference_implementations.name: Haskell/GHC
reference_implementations.mechanism: Interface and per-declaration fingerprints to avoid recompilation
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Fingerprint effective exported entities and invalidate only importers of changed APIs

reference_implementations.name: C#/Roslyn incremental generators
reference_implementations.mechanism: Incremental value-provider graph and cache-friendly deterministic transforms
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Track annotation/macro-generated declarations as versioned, deterministic query outputs

reference_implementations.name: Elixir/Mix
reference_implementations.mechanism: Compile-time vs runtime module dependency tracking
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Distinguish semantic/compile-time imports from runtime-only edges; actor protocol consolidation is a distinct output

reference_implementations.name: Zig compiler
reference_implementations.mechanism: Compiler/watch incremental compilation with linked code emission (some modes evolving)
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Keep file/function and target-object invalidation separate; claim stable behavior only after executing supported target modes

reference_implementations.name: Dart/Flutter dev pipeline
reference_implementations.mechanism: Incremental source reload to running VM during debug
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Treat hot loading as separate state-preserving runtime protocol, not proof of native AOT incremental build

reference_implementations.name: OCaml/Dune
reference_implementations.mechanism: Memoized rule graph and build cache with reproducibility checks
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Add randomly sampled cache re-execution and deterministic artifact equivalence checking

reference_implementations.name: Java/Gradle
reference_implementations.mechanism: ABI-aware compilation avoidance and incremental Java compilation
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Reuse unaffected importer outputs when bodies change, but invalidate on effective ABI changes

reference_implementations.name: C#/.NET MSBuild
reference_implementations.mechanism: Declared inputs/outputs and incremental target skipping
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Explicit per-step input/output manifests and canonical build action keys

reference_implementations.name: Java/Maven Compiler Plugin
reference_implementations.mechanism: Module/source change detection; coarser incremental modes
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Avoid calling coarse module timestamp checks equivalent to semantic compiler incrementality

reference_implementations.name: Bazel
reference_implementations.mechanism: Content-addressed action cache and optional remote reuse
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Hermetic action key includes toolchain, options, inputs, environment and declared dependencies

reference_implementations.name: Buck2/DICE
reference_implementations.mechanism: Dynamic memoized dependency computation graph and incremental actions
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Use dynamic dependency edges, incremental graph recomputation and safe parallel scheduling

reference_implementations.name: Pants
reference_implementations.mechanism: Fine-grained file dependency inference, memoized hermetic engine
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Package file-level source membership plus verified dependency inference and selective invalidation

reference_implementations.name: Ninja
reference_implementations.mechanism: Explicit file graph, depfiles and restat-based incremental actions
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Emit real depfiles/output manifests; avoid changed timestamps triggering unchanged downstream outputs

reference_implementations.name: CMake/Ninja generator
reference_implementations.mechanism: Generated Ninja target graph with depfile integration
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Support standardized build graph integration without inventing a new unsupported build orchestrator

reference_implementations.name: webpack 5
reference_implementations.mechanism: Persistent filesystem module graph cache and dependency-based invalidation
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Persist module/namespace transforms and invalidate when config, plugin or file dependency changes

reference_implementations.name: Vite
reference_implementations.mechanism: Environment-specific module graphs and precise HMR invalidation
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Keep isolated target/runtime-profile graphs; version invalidation across client/worker/host actors

reference_implementations.name: esbuild
reference_implementations.mechanism: Persistent context rebuild/watch and incremental in-process graph reuse
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Fast in-session reuse is valuable but not a substitute for process-restart persistence

reference_implementations.name: Rollup
reference_implementations.mechanism: Watch rebuilds and reusable module cache
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Model target fragments, dynamic imports and accurate external dependency invalidation

reference_implementations.name: Parcel
reference_implementations.mechanism: Disk cache of transforms and granular invalidation of config/plugin inputs
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Treat codegen plugins/macros/feature configuration as first-class cache inputs

reference_implementations.name: Angular compiler/build
reference_implementations.mechanism: Incremental AOT-oriented build system and partial library output
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Separate ahead-of-time analysis/emission/linking and preserve correct generated dependency provenance

reference_implementations.name: Nx
reference_implementations.mechanism: Task/affected project graph and hash-based local/remote result replay
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Explain exact rebuild reasons and permit optional trusted workspace/CI artifact reuse

reference_implementations.name: Turborepo
reference_implementations.mechanism: Global plus per-task hashes with local and remote task caches
reference_implementations.atto_takeaway: Include environment/toolchain dependencies in cache keys and ensure reproducible output manifests

implemented_unverified: Java in-memory per-file parsed AST reuse
source/interface/import-binding fingerprint invalidation with conservative reverse closure
file fallback for source without explicit namespace
15 focused JUnit tests authored, source workflow zero-step
design_only: package-instance-qualified namespaces spanning multiple verified sources
transitive inline/specialization/dependent ABI invalidation across compiler phases
not_demonstrated: persistent cache reused after process exit
atto_baseline.claim_guard: never treat authoring tests, source-free runner checks, zero-step Actions, or Python planner tests as executed Java/LLVM/.NET/etc compiler evidence

priorities.title: Prove one correct Java frontend slice
priorities.scope: verified 15-case JUnit, real source/diagnostics, warm/no-op/negative import/borrow effects, no bypass of actor admission
priorities.done_when: actual nonzero runner steps + clean-vs-incremental diagnostics parity + independently reviewed CI path

priorities.title: Bind packages/namespaces and precise semantic dependencies
priorities.scope: manifest+lock package-instance ID, one unit per unnamespaced file, shared namespace interface graph, negative lookups, nominal actor/ownership/effect/inline edges, SCC interface-first
priorities.done_when: 12-file/3-namespace plus unnamespaced fixture with exact rebuild-set oracle and negative cases

priorities.title: Persist deterministic semantic/compiler graph
priorities.scope: versioned CAS for parse/typed/HIR/MIR/declaration fingerprint, restart/recovery, corruption and toolchain-profile detection, atomic publish and concurrent cancellation
priorities.done_when: restart in a second process reports true disk hits, corruption rechecks, no stale ownership evidence

priorities.title: Incremental codegen, linking and target artifacts
priorities.scope: per backend IR/object/ESM/Wasm/CIL/RTL artifact hashes, inline specialization graph, link vs compile counters, AOT profile partitioning
priorities.done_when: real emitted artifact + guest output/diagnostic parity and targeted recompilation for supported modes

priorities.title: Build UX, hermeticity and optional trusted remote cache
priorities.scope: --explain-incremental stable machine report, local cache first, target/toolchain/env/key provenance, optional verified remote cache, p50/p95 timings and RSS
priorities.done_when: reproducible benchmark receipts, process-restart reuse and hermetic cache adversarial tests across supported backends

performance_protocol: parallel build with cancellation and unstable source snapshot
